انتحلنا (form VIII)
# اِنْتَحَلْنَا (intaḥalnā) /in.ta.ħal.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِنْتَحَلَ (intaḥala)
# اُنْتُحِلْنَا (untuḥilnā) /un.tu.ħil.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِنْتَحَلَ (intaḥala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
